name: Text
description: Simple text section with eyebrow, title (with <strong> accent support), subline, body, and up to two CTAs. Layouts: left-aligned, centered, two-column (title left / body right), or an oversize headline that breaks the grid.
when_to_use: Pure copy blocks — mission statements, section intros, editorial passages without media. Use Intro when an image belongs next to the text; use Cta when the block's job is conversion.
capabilities: four layouts incl. editorial two-column and oversize display headline
title <strong> emphasis rendered in the accent color

variants.description: Title left, body right in two columns.
Huge display headline; subline, body, contact and CTAs stacked below in one centered column.

breakpoints.mobile: Single column everywhere; oversize headline scales down.
breakpoints.desktop: Two-column split for the two-col variant.

btn-label.none: covered by the CTA Primary / CTA Secondary content keys

eyebrow-text.none: covered by the Eyebrow content key

text-mod-subline.none: covered by the Subline content key

body-text.none: covered by the Body content key

text-mod-title.none: covered by the TitleLight / TitleBold content keys

text-mod-oversize-title.none: covered by the TitleLight / TitleBold content keys

ai.prompt_summary: Text: copy-only section. Settings: variant (left|center|two-col|oversize), eyebrow, title (supports <strong> accent), subline (short sentence between title and body), body, contact_org + contact_lines (optional contact block below the body: bold organisation name, then one line per address/phone/e-mail row), primary_label + primary_to, secondary_label + secondary_to. heading_level (h1|h2|h3, default h2) sets the title's tag. Optional design override heading_case (default|upper); leave 'default' unless the design asks.
ai.content_guidelines: Title 3-8 words with at most one <strong> emphasis (oversize titles even shorter). Body 2-5 sentences. CTAs optional — primary before secondary.

field_hints.title: Wrap the emphasized phrase in ...; it renders in the brand accent color.
field_hints.subline: One short bridging sentence — not a second paragraph.
field_hints.contact_lines: One entry per line, e.g. 'Hauptstraße 42, 12345 Musterstadt' / 'T. +49 6135 12 34 56' / 'E. hallo@musterfirma.de'. Leave contact_org and contact_lines empty unless the section names a contact.
